_comment: Rules for the refresh drip strategy. Pages that match these criteria should be updated with fresh data rather than left to go stale.

refreshTriggers.description: The underlying data has changed (new funding round, valuation update, earnings report)
refreshTriggers.action: Update the page with new data, update lastmod, add a 'Last updated' line

refreshTriggers.description: Page dropped from position ≤10 to position >10 in the last 7 days
refreshTriggers.action: Refresh content, add new sections, update title if CTR also dropped

refreshTriggers.description: A competitor published newer content on the same topic
refreshTriggers.action: Update with fresher data and deeper analysis to reclaim freshness signal

refreshTriggers.description: New queries are appearing for this page that the content doesn't address
refreshTriggers.action: Add sections that directly answer the new queries

refreshTriggers.description: Content references a specific date or time period that is now past
refreshTriggers.action: Update date references, add current data, note what changed

refreshChecklist: Update any stale data points or statistics
Add new developments since last update
Check that all external links still work
Update the FAQ section with new questions from GSC query data
Update the lastmod/lastUpdated field in frontmatter
Add internal links to any new related content published since last update
Verify structured data is still valid
Re-check title against current top queries — rewrite if intent shifted
doNotRefresh: Pages in the KILL bucket — delete instead
Pages scheduled for MERGE — consolidate first
Pages with <50 impressions in 28 days — not worth the effort
Pages where the topic is fully dead (seasonal, one-time event that passed)
